## SYNTHESIS 2026-07-28 — what actually puts a task in band

Tally after this round: **20+ tasks rejected at easiness/difficulty for being too easy, 2 passed** (remat-schedule 4/8 and protocol-clone v2 4/8; reactive-spreadsheet also cleared earlier). The most recent pass is
protocol-clone v2 (easiness 0/3, difficulty 4/8). Every rejected task was solved 3/3 or 2/3.
(remat-schedule is the one non-metered pass, and its analogue of metering is a SEALED BAR the agent
cannot evaluate against -- it can compute its own cost but never knows if it cleared. Same family:
the agent is denied the signal that would tell it when it is done.)

Hypotheses this round KILLED, each with its counterexample:
- *"a big measured cliff separates"* — telemetry-codec had a 3.3x cliff, held-out data and
  all-or-nothing binary grading. Solved 3/3.
- *"long solve times mean it is nearly hard enough"* — operator-repair 44-115 min, frustrated-cluster
  76-92% of budget, scratchpad-kernels 61-77 min. All 3/3. Runtime is not the binding variable.
- *"binary failure beats a continuous metric"* — true as far as it goes, but telemetry-codec and
  operator-repair are both binary and both died.
- *"a big bespoke system nobody can rewrite"* — operator-repair, 1000 loc, 6 ablated defects. 3/3.

The ONE structural property protocol-clone has that none of the other 15 have: **the information
channel is METERED.** Every other task lets the agent learn everything it needs for free — from a
complete spec, a shipped corpus, a local test loop, or an unlimited reference it can diff against.
protocol-clone caps what can be learned at 1400 client frames, ~2.3x a designed 610-frame plan, and
the measurement in task-src/protocol-clone/last_failure.md shows undirected exploration never
converges at any budget worth simulating.

**Working conclusion for the next Software build: meter the information channel, or expect 3/3.**
This reverses the earlier caution about reusing the metered-oracle mechanism for similarity reasons.
protocol-clone itself passed similarity with matches:[] against resolver-conformance despite both
being 'deliberately incomplete written contract' tasks, so the gate keys on environment structure and
semantics, not on the difficulty mechanism. Vary the substrate (not a wire protocol) and the
topology (not a compose sidecar on /run), keep the meter.

The 14 ablations are real (7 to 185 of 341 lines each) and bought NOTHING, because a frontier agent never takes the naive branch, which is coil-draw v1's lesson landing a second time. The plumbing-only proof sheet denied an oracle to no purpose: THE SPEC WAS THE ORACLE. GENERAL RULE WORTH MORE THAN THE BUNDLE: where an artifact is graded by exact match against a published rule set, difficulty cannot come from the number or subtlety of the rules, because fairness forces publication and publication kills it. Ablation size measures that a reading matters if you get it wrong, never that anyone would get it wrong. Added a sixth graded field, `weight`: the sum over every retained sample of that sample's index modulo a modulus, doubled past heavy_stage, with the modulus itself switching at cal_switch. The other five fields are counters an event walk carries; weight is a SUM, so between two events it is the sum of an arithmetic progression taken modulo wk and has to be closed over the residue cycle (period = wk // gcd(decim, wk)) rather than iterated. An implementation that walks retained samples to accumulate it is back to 1e14 steps and has gained nothing from jumping. Two new late rules came free with it (wk2, heavy_stage). ## placement-equivalence-classes (Software/Systems, $300) — BUILT + all local gates green 2026-09-16, HELD (manual submit)
FRESH CORE for the account: **decide behavioural INDISTINGUISHABILITY**. 24 storage keys sit on a
sealed gRPC shard router (compose sidecar, grpcio 1.76.0); the deliverable `/app/classes.json` is the
exact partition of those keys into interchangeable classes — a quotient, two-sided, all-or-nothing,
14 classes over 24 keys. A merge is a ∀-claim over every finite operation sequence, which probing
can never certify, so the only honest route is to rebuild the machine and reason about it. Distinct
from the account's metered family: admit-nudge (∃ min edit), quota-cert (∀ safety cert), intake-order
(ordering), interlock-repair (automaton + min edit), promote-path (action sequence), throttle-map /
redis-compat-audit / dialect-check / cwnd-echo (reproduce). BUNDLE ARCHITECTURE deliberately moved
off the metered scaffold (array-vet lesson): **no answer key ships** — the verifier derives the
grouping at grading time by bisimulation over the router's own policy, replays a separating witness
for every cross-class pair and checks no intra-class pair has one, then compares.
MEASURED LEVERS (dev-backup/ablate.py): `seal` silently disables `compact` for the window and returns
the same `ok`, so a probe that seals before compacting reads the same refund for every key (9 groups,
4 wrongly merged); two refusals in one window cut the quota by 2, so push-till-it-breaks-then-confirm
returns a wrong self-consistent number (9 groups, 4 merged); inert dimensions (region/burst invisible
on shared keys, burst invisible on `lite` whose quota never reaches the exposing level) mean splitting
on every attribute probed is wrong (24 groups, 8 split apart); the shipped tenancy export lies on 4
rows both ways (23 groups; with perfect inertness reasoning still 13 groups, 3 merged 3 split); a
fixed random battery at the full per-key allowance (37 ops/key) reproduces the exact partition only
9.0% of 300 trials. GATES: oracle 1.000 source + extracted zip, nop 0.000, reference spends 593 of
900 charged operations, 10 fabricated submissions all reward 0 through the real verifier, agent image
carries no sealed data, pins clean, no canary. harbor check not run (no API key). BAND UNMEASURED;
dial = STAGING_ALLOWANCE 900 in environment/docker-compose.yaml (also in /app/NOTES.md and
difficulty_explanation, sweep together). Author Anand Pahade. Sheet
tasks/placement-equivalence-classes/SUBMISSION.md.

## delivery-guarantee-audit (Software/Systems, $300) — BUILT + all local gates green 2026-09-16, HELD (manual submit)
FRESH CORE for the account: **adjudicate a written guarantee document against a running
deployment, per clause, two sided, with a REPLAYABLE WITNESS for every clause called broken.**
Twelve messaging guarantees (MG-1..MG-12) ship as /app/GUARANTEES.md; a staging event backbone
runs a sealed stream/consumer configuration behind a metering relay (real broker, real
JetStream semantics, nats-server 2.11.9 + nats-py 2.12.0). Seven broken, five hold. `holds` is a
claim about every operation sequence that could run, so probing can never certify it; `broken`
must be earned with an operation sequence that reproduces the breach FROM A CLEAN START, which
is strictly harder than spotting an anomaly on a staging copy already disturbed. Distinct from
the metered family: admit-nudge (∃ min edit), placement-equivalence-classes (∀ quotient),
quota-cert (∀ safe set), intake-order (ordering), promote-path (action sequence), throttle-map /
redis-compat-audit / dialect-check / cwnd-echo (reproduce).
SEVEN DRIFTS, each chosen so the NATURAL probe returns a confident wrong `holds`: producer-id
dedup is stream wide not per subject (same-subject probe collapses correctly); an undocumented
per-subject cap trims the oldest while the documented 400 ceiling refuses as promised; one
consumer acknowledges in bulk (acking the FIRST delivery looks correct, only out-of-order acking
exposes it); a refund subject is transformed into the capture namespace (the delivery presents
under the subject the filter expects, and a direct read of the published subject is empty); one
consumer is bound past the seeded backlog (a fresh publish arrives fine); purge names a subject
that is already empty (publish/purge/read the same subject is empty either way); one consumer
sits below the in-flight floor. **A naive audit reports ZERO breaches, confidently.**
/app/EDGE-RECORD.md is the change history and LIES BOTH WAYS: five changes it declares closed are
live, two deviations it declares are fiction -> trusting it gives five false clearances and two
false accusations. METERING: 300 charged client messages, global, across connections, no top up,
refusals charged; `read` is one batched direct get so one message sent = one unit; reference
spends 168. The documented 400 ceiling is out of brute-force reach. Info denial is REAL broker
authorisation (auditor seat has no stream/consumer introspection) plus a relay that refuses any
CONNECT presenting another identity. GRADING: verdicts must match AND every witness must replay —
fresh provision per witness, full observation rights, one breach monitor per guarantee written
from the shipped page; witnesses are data against a fixed grammar (<=80 ops), never executed.
truth.self_check() refuses to grade if the provisioned config no longer contains a drift the
verdict table is owed to. GATES: oracle 1.000 source (twice) + extracted zip, nop 0.000,
**23/23 cheats and ablations reward 0** incl. five `force_mgN` witnesses that try to breach
guarantees which genuinely hold (two-sidedness proven) and nine crossing ablations where the
natural probe replaces the crossing. harbor check not run (no API key). BAND UNMEASURED; dials =
AUDIT_ALLOWANCE 300 in environment/docker-compose.yaml, and (stronger) the drift count in
tests/truth.py + environment/staging/deployment.py. Author Anand Pahade. Sheet
tasks/delivery-guarantee-audit/SUBMISSION.md.

## malloc-acceptance — v3 FIXTURE-ROBUSTNESS fix 2026-09-19 after run_audit FAILED (task specification 7/8)
BIG milestone: v2 PASSED structural/ai/similarity/reference/quality/anti-cheat/EASINESS, and the DIFFICULTY
probe (0/8 solved, band 0-7 = genuinely hard). Only the RUN AUDIT failed: "task specification 7/8" +
"near miss advisory 8/8". Cause = latent bugs in my CONFORMANT fixtures that crash/hang/OOM under aggressive
LEGAL probing, so agents that probed hard got FALSE REJECTIONS of conformant variants (fairness fail, NOT a
difficulty fail). Judge root-caused 3: v_usable_big's np2 `while(p<n) p<<=1` HANGS for n>2^63 (malloc(SIZE_MAX)
probe never returns; hit ~7/8); v_malloc_zero zero-fills full usable so multi-GB probes OOM the 2GB cgroup;
v_memalign_overalign's doubled alignment hits dlmalloc's realloc-after-memalign mmap SEGV. LESSON: a conformant
fixture must survive EVERY legal probe a frontier agent issues (huge->NULL, no hang, no crash, no OOM), not just
the reference's own probes. FIX: built robust.c stress (SIZE_MAX, huge-no-write, realloc-after-memalign at all
aligns, calloc-huge) and ran ALL conformant thru it. Found the crash is dlmalloc's dlrealloc-of-memalign; fixed
by making base.c realloc + v_realloc0_free relocate via malloc+copy+free (v_realloc_move was the only stress-clean
variant); guarded v_usable_big np2 (n>2^47 -> NULL); capped v_malloc_zero zeroing to <=16MB; dropped v_realloc_move
(now == base). All 13 conformant now stress-clean; reference grades 32/32; ablation unchanged. Shipped dlmalloc_wrap.c
realloc made robust too (agent's local dlmalloc == verifier's). Local green: verifier oracle 1 (34 pass)/nop 0/cheats 0,
env accepts 5, counts fixed (13 conf/19 faulty). Zip 24 files 139 KB. Difficulty should HOLD (the real judgment
traps like aligned_alloc-notmult tripped agents independently; 0/8 was not caused by the fixture bugs alone).

## fixed-point-widths (Hardware/RTL, $200) — v1 category fail, v2 EASINESS 3/3, v3 hardened but NOT SUBMITTED
**v3 is local-green only.** The last version the pipeline saw is v2, which died the easiness probe.
**VERDICT v2 2026-09-23:** structural PASSED, AI check PASSED, similarity PASSED, reference verification
PASSED, quality review PASSED, anti-cheat PASSED, **easiness probe FAILED 3 of 3** (fable-5-1 low;
2h2m / 23m50s / solved; 55.9k/15.0k out tok; $5.37/$1.96). The 24-minute trial is the diagnosis: v2 was a
single-objective area minimisation against a MONOTONE feasibility oracle, so widening always fixed
accuracy and single-bit greedy plus one or two exhaustive checks solved it. My own screen
(restart-greedy SPREAD) had said greedy == anneal and I shipped anyway.
**v3 HARDENED IN PLACE** (same subject, deliverable, verifier architecture): 45-site kernel with EIGHT
PARALLEL BRANCHES; operators become library macros at widths 12..24 with published area AND DELAY, so
both area and the clock are step functions; a small-signal accuracy bound; five requirements at once
(no wrap, 2^-9 global, 2^-10 small-signal, path <= 510, area <= 8402).
**The mechanism that makes it hard: timing is a MAX over the eight branches, so narrowing any single
site leaves the critical path EXACTLY where it was (measured) - single-site greedy cannot close timing
at all.** The widest uniform width that fits the clock is 18: area 8394 and path 484.5 BOTH PASS and it
fails accuracy at 113%/107% exactly (shipped as the `uniform_width` cheat, scores 0). Recovering that
accuracy costs clock period and only 25.5 units of slack exist; the payoff is in the ADDER TREE (a
quarter of a multiplier's delay, truncation lands on the output), which is where an area-driven pass
never looks. Reference: timing base -> spend slack by error-per-delay -> take area back -> confirm on
all 2^36 triples; lands 8402 / path 495.0 / 86.5% / 74.6%, first confirmation.
**Two real bugs found while hardening:** the 16-frac-bit reference was itself the error floor (wrong in
SHIPPED v2 too; raised to 26), and test_formats.py kept REF_F=16 after everything else moved to 26, so
the verifier graded against a coarser reference and let the uniform_width trap PASS - caught only
because that cheat scored 1.
**v3 local gates (extracted zip): harbor oracle 1.000 (37m40s quiet box), nop 0.000 (5m17s), all 12
cheats reward 0 including the two structural traps (uniform_width, accurate_over_clock).
anchor_check verilator [NEST]. zip 40 files / 43.3 KB. harbor check not runnable (no API key).**

### v1/v2 history
**VERDICT v1 2026-09-22:** structural PASSED, AI check PASSED (hand-written, first try), similarity PASSED,
reference verification PASSED, **quality review FAILED on the single blocking criterion `category and tags`**:
"the task is fixed-point word-length sign-off for a hardware datapath, verified against synthesizable
SystemVerilog under Verilator. Hardware (subcategory such as Digital Design or DSP) reflects the primary
skill exercised; Systems suggests OS/networking-style systems software, which this is not." EVERY other
criterion passed - difficult, novel, interesting, essential difficulty, anti cheat robustness, solvable,
solution quality, test instruction alignment, difficulty/solution/verification explanation quality.
Probes (anti-cheat, easiness, difficulty, run audit) never ran.
**v2 FIX, metadata only:** category Hardware / subcategory RTL (Hardware offers only CAD and RTL),
tag `embedded` -> `rtl`. Graded path untouched; nop re-verified 0.000 after the edit.
LESSON: the Verilator/SystemVerilog layer I added to satisfy anchor_check also RE-HOMED the task -
if the shipped framing is silicon sign-off ("going to silicon", "tape out", "the datapath team"),
the category follows the framing, and the payout tier follows the category.

### v1 build notes
FRESH family (fixed-point bit-width sign-off / RTL width allocation; 0 prior in the catalogue).
Deliverable: `/app/out/formats.json`, one `[I, F, mode]` per site of a 22-site DSP kernel (gain-staged
cubic soft clipper, envelope/sample modulation path, even-harmonic path; inputs x,e,g in Q1.11).
Two requirements over EVERY one of the 2^36 input triples: P1 no site wraps its stored W=I+F bits,
P2 |y - y_exact| <= 2^-10 against a 16-fraction-bit truncating integer reference. Area (mulv Wa*Wb,
mulc Wa*15, add max, +W per rounding site) must be <= 3245. All three inputs re-enter the dataflow
late, so no site cuts the graph and the check cannot be factored.

**Verifier = exhaustive C enumeration** (generated + compiled by the verifier from its own kernel copy,
run as uid 65534, early-exit on the first violation). Deterministic, no SAT variance, no sealed answer.
Z3 was the v1 design and was DROPPED: it proves the overflow side cheaply (27 CPU-s/cell at 12-bit)
but never finished a single accuracy cell (>168 CPU-s at 12-bit; >60 CPU-min for 64 cells at 14-bit).

**Anchor: Verilator 5.032.** The block also ships as synthesisable SystemVerilog (`tools/mkv.py`), every
site a signed wire of exactly W bits, so the forbidden wrap is a literal bit select. The verifier
verilates the RTL built from the agent's formats and requires bit-exact agreement with the C model.
anchor_check: verilator [NEST].

**Measured difficulty (all exhaustive):** widest legal 4988 (11% of eps) · spreadsheet from interval
bounds + reverse-accumulated gains 3863 · greedy shave trusting a 4M+corners sample 3217 but **128% of
eps** · 3-restart anneal at 10% margin 3116 but **111%** · same at 28% margin on 4M 3184 but **103%** ·
anneal at 35% margin 3281 (over budget) · greedy at 28% margin 3411 (over budget) · **reference
3245 at 88% of eps**. Every fast route either lands under budget and fails P2, or passes P2 and lands
over budget. The window is found only by calibrating the sample's optimism against an exhaustive run.
Corner trap: (-1)*(-1)=+1 needs I=2 at t1/ge; a sample without the 7^3 corners wraps at (-2048,-2048,-2048).

Local gates from the extracted zip: **oracle 1.000, nop 0.000** (oracle 2h02 wall incl. verifier under
load 25-65; solve.sh alone 72 min on a quiet box, 3.3x headroom against the 14400 s agent budget).
Verifier image: reward 1 on the reference (6/6 tests), **reward 0 on all 12 cheats** (8 schema +
wide_over_budget, too_narrow, sample_greedy, margin_tuned). Robustness: 52 random legal assignments
(incl. degenerate 1-bit, all-integer, all-fraction) verilate and match the C model bit-for-bit,
0 failures. anchor_check: verilator [NEST]. harbor check not run (no API key).
